reviews.comment:
He parado en campings del ACA siendo socio y sin serlo, siempre sin problemas. Está vez era de noche y quise parar a descansar en el "camping" que esta YPF tiene al costado pero me exigieron ser socio del ACA para dejarme pasar. No les cargue combustible y seguí hasta la próxima YPF. Raro que el ACA discrimine, voy a averiguar está practica. Mala experiencia.

(Translated by Google)
I've stopped at ACA campsites both as a member and as a non-member, always without problems. This time it was nighttime and I wanted to stop and rest at the "campsite" next to this YPF station, but they demanded I be an ACA member to let me in. I didn't fill up and continued on to the next YPF. It's strange that the ACA discriminates; I'm going to look into this practice. Bad experience.
